0022600087.text: Both the Hornets and Nets open their 2026-27 seasons when Charlotte visits Brooklyn. The Hornets are dealing with four day-to-day players: Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee), with White, Williams and Knueppel all listed as game-time decisions. Brooklyn is without Joshua Jefferson, who is out with a back ailment, and Charlotte won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 win in Brooklyn in their most recent meeting on March 31, 2026.
